summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO prototype entered through the MMORPG Tools menu and character-creation flow. The Lantern March is authored across place configs, hand-placed scenes and procedural terrain/prop scripts; the MMORPG Tools mod owns RPG lifecycle and UI, while core scripts own movement and the first Vanguard combat loop.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - title/travel menu scene with authored town art and shared terrain decoration.
places/character-creation-land/ - character preview scene with preview camera and lighting setup.
places/main/ - Lantern March continent: Reach hub at origin, Windmill Farm SW, Briarwild west, quarry east and distant regions across 29 cells.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Reach hub, including smithy armory and fenced training yard with three Vanguard training dummies; townhouse uses procedural/kit assets.
roots: world.config.yaml - defaultPlace main-menu-land; binds shared player, camera, arrival, MMORPG UI and nametag behavior.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod.json - registers MMORPG template and menu, player, interaction, quest and gameplay/creation camera behaviors.
templates/player.js#player - native player template; runs humanoid-locomotion, core movement, then scripts/vanguard.js.
templates/camera.js#camera - native custom camera template; core scripts/camera.js consumes engine look orientation.
places/main-menu-land/config.yaml and places/character-creation-land/config.yaml - menu and preview place roots with their atmosphere settings.
places/main/config.yaml - playable-world spawn, gravity, terrain generator/materials, vegetation scatter and cinematic look.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ - integrated RPG package for character lifecycle, gameplay/creation cameras, interactions, quests and UI.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - shared RPG data registries and panel renderers consumed by mod behaviors and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/item-icons.js - item-id icon registry reused by inventory rendering; iconFor falls back to an item's existing icon.
scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, stone-bridge.js, farm.js and windmill*.js - procedural geometry used by authored scene instances with parameters.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, pebble.js and grass-look.js - terrain decoration geometry/material reused by place scatter bindings.
scripts/lib/regions.js - named Lantern March region definitions and regionAt lookup; ui-hud.js mirrors region tests inline.
scripts/lib/data/{player,camera,world}.yml - shared movement, camera-height and terrain-height values read by core scripts.
scripts/lib/data/vanguard.yml - shared Vanguard combat and training-dummy tuning consumed by scripts/vanguard.js and scripts/training-dummy.js.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onInput, update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - sit, onInput, update.
scripts/vanguard.js - onInput, endAction, land; scripts/training-dummy.js - onSpawn, update, settle, standUp.
scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber, update; scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/terrain-reach.js - QUARRY, FOREST, CRYPT, FEN, BAY, heightAt, materialAt; scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt.
scripts/gen/stone-bridge.js, farm.js, windmill.js and windmill-sails.js - geometry, collider; scripts/gen/shape.js supplies box/quad helpers.
scripts/sails-spin.js - onSpawn; animates the windmill sail assembly.

mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js - gameplay-character, roster, persistence, spatial-audio and character-data helpers; building-interact.js and quest-giver.js expose their building/quest handlers.

mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/shop-data.js - hasShop, getShopItems, findShopItem; lib/item-icons.js - ITEM_ICONS, iconFor; lib/ui-inventory.js - buildItemTooltip, eqSlot, eqSlotLarge, renderInventory.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent keyed by body, core character velocity and terrain-dependent footstep timing/index; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw, animation channels and seated locomotion.
scripts/camera.js - core camera rig eye pose and local-player hiding; engine view provides orientation.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js and character-select.js - MMORPG player/character creation state, roster transitions, persistence, UI action handling and UI action sounds.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js and camera-creation.js - orbit input/pose and creation-phase framing for the mod camera path.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/quest-giver.js - NPC proximity and quest-dialog handoff and offer/open sounds; quest definitions live in lib/quest-data.js.
scripts/vanguard.js - player action cooldown/busy scratch in ctx.session and player cooldown/guard state and action animation; scripts/training-dummy.js owns dummy hp/down/reaction state.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js and lib/ui-*.js - render presentation from player/world state; places/main/config.yaml and scripts/terrain-reach.js own terrain inputs.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → MMORPG menu/player/character-select/main-menu-mgr behaviors → character creation and transition into main.
Character creation confirm in character-select.js → name registry check and character state/persistence; registry failure creates an active character id and continues loading.
Creation camera behavior path in mod.json → character-select.js installs camera-creation.js → frames preview; gameplay camera handles orbit outside creation.
world.config.yaml player template → humanoid-locomotion.js then player.js then vanguard.js; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.
moveX/moveZ/jump input → scripts/player.js onInput stores room-local intent → update eases velocity, applies place gravity and emits nearby terrain-selected footsteps when grounded and moving.
attack/castSlot2/castSlot3 inputs in main → scripts/vanguard.js maps slots 1/2/3 to strike/heavy/guard, plays action animation and schedules hit/action-end handlers using vanguard.yml timings.

Vanguard land handler → nearby enemy-tagged objects with positive state.hp, filtered by forward arc and reach → striker machine subtracts target hp and writes lastHitBy/lastHitAt/lastHitKind; emits hit FX, damage number, sound and camera feedback.
training-dummy.js observes changed state.lastHitAt → hit-reel or down animation; ctx.after schedules settle or standUp, which restores hp after vanguard.yml dummyReset.
world.config.yaml UI renderer → mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js reads local player/world state → lib/ui-* renderers compose HUD, menu, quest and panels; nametag renders separately.
Main-place local player's feetPosition x/z → ui-hud.js inline region tests → name over minimap; scripts/lib/regions.js exports corresponding lookup data but is not imported by this HUD path.

quest-giver.js proximity/interact → lib/quest-data.js and player activeQuests → showQuestDialog/questDialogData on player → ui.js/lib/ui-quest.js; building panel actions similarly connect shop data to player gold/inventory.

places/main/config.yaml terrain generator → scripts/terrain-reach.js heightAt/materialAt and scatter bindings; scene entities use scripts/gen geometry or model assets, while windmill sails animate via scripts/sails-spin.js.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, stone-bridge.js, farm.js and windmill*.js - procedural scene geometry reused by instances, varied by kind/shape parameters, dimensions, seed and transforms.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by density, scale and seed; grass-look supplies material separately.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle behaviors registered by mod.json.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js and camera-creation.js - paired gameplay orbit and preview camera modes with creation-phase guards.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-*.js - modular panel renderers composed by ui.js for HUD, menu, quest, inventory, map, character and settings.

scripts/vanguard.js and scripts/training-dummy.js with scripts/lib/data/vanguard.yml - one player melee discipline and target reaction loop shared across three placed training dummies, varied by ability and per-dummy state.
scripts/look-default.js and mods/aaa-quality-kit/look-cinema.js - alternative whole-frame post-process looks selected by place atmosphere.

art/tools/build.py and art/townhouse/build.py - asset-building pipelines; tool builder exports OBJ assets separately and townhouse builder assembles kit modules with hand-built structure and exterior/yard pieces.
migrationNotes: Keep core movement intent and locomotion scratch in room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity and place config owns gravity.
templates/player.js runs humanoid-locomotion before player.js; behavior order means gait samples prior-tick movement velocity, with vanguard.js last for combat input.
Core scripts/camera.js uses engine look orientation and feetPosition + eyeHeight × effectiveScale.y; MMORPG orbit/creation cameras are a distinct path.
Vanguard timings/cooldowns/reach/damage use seconds, metres and hit points in scripts/lib/data/vanguard.yml; action hits are scheduled and damage is applied directly on striker to target.state.hp.
Vanguard selects the first live enemy in query order within reach and a 75-degree half-angle; guard writes guardUntil/guardReduce, while dummy reset is a delayed local handler.
Terrain footsteps query heightAt/materialAt beneath feet; region labels remain duplicated because ui-hud.js hardcodes ordered coordinate tests instead of calling scripts/lib/regions.js.
